full_text:
Ms. Shrodinger is an elderly woman who served as the caretaker of an orphanage in Rotterdam, Netherlands. 

== History ==
As the caretaker of the orphanage, Ms. Shrodinger cared over Den and Harrison Fears, Bruno and Dirk. She was approached by Tantras, who used a Skingrip spell to incapacitate her in order to convert and train her orphans as acolytes of the Blood Spiral. Her fate after the Blood Spiral left remains unknown. [Den vs Harrison]

== Personality ==
Ms. Shrodinger was negligent in her duties as the orphanage was a cold and miserable place and bullying was rife under her watch, with Den Fears having to step up to protect the weaker children. [S2E36]

== Trivia ==
* Ms. Shrodinger's name may be a reference to Erwin Schrödinger and the Schrödinger's cat thought experiment.

'''Ms. Shrodinger''' is an elderly woman who served as the caretaker of an [[Rotterdam Orphanage|<nowiki/>]]orphanage in [[Rotterdam, Netherlands]]. 

== History ==
As the caretaker of the orphanage, Ms. Shrodinger cared over [[Den Fears|Den]] and [[Harrison Fears]], [[Bruno]] and [[Dirk]]. She was approached by [[Tantras]], who used a [[Skingrip]] spell to incapacitate her in order to convert and train her orphans as [[Silent Soldiers|acolytes]] of the [[Blood Spiral]]. Her fate after the [[Blood Spiral]] left remains unknown. {{source|Den vs Harrison}}

== Personality ==
Ms. Shrodinger was negligent in her duties as the orphanage was a cold and miserable place and bullying was rife under her watch, with Den Fears having to step up to protect the weaker children. {{source|S2E36}}

== Trivia ==
* Ms. Shrodinger's name may be a reference to [[wikipedia:Erwin Schrödinger|Erwin Schrödinger]] and the [[wikipedia:Schrödinger's cat|Schrödinger's cat]] thought experiment.
